statements.t: Looking ahead, we believe the first half of 2027 could be a transformative period for Taysha with our plan to report data from the six-month interim analysis of our REVEAL pivotal trial along with expected FDA feedback on our BLA submission pathway, and the anticipated nomination of a second gene therapy development program with a high unmet medical need and robust commercial opportunity as we begin building a…
